scene_summary: A paper-archive plate built from beige folders, vertical receipt strips, barcode bands, translucent preservation film, black custody rails, and a central folded aperture. A cyan scanner crosshair runs through the torn legal-form rupture, with smaller notches, labels, stamped cuts, film corners, and edge blocks available as tight interaction surfaces.
usable_surfaces: central folded legal-form aperture around cyan crosshair
long vertical receipt and barcode strips
black brushed-metal custody rails with pinholes
manila folder tab notch near lower center
thin graphite scanner seams and barcode bands
